{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1793036346380,"sessionID":"ses_e86c4ad00ffebEWOAOBwCvDahy","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01NAXDJ6EogxbaMTimRnHyv3","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/qtclustering_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_mpi_r3/qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","content":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - MPI Distributed Version\n//\n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n//\n// Parallelization: in every round, the candidate seeds are distributed\n// cyclically across MPI ranks. Each rank grows candidate clusters for its\n// seeds, the globally best seed (largest cardinality, ties broken by lowest\n// seed index) is selected with MPI_MAXLOC, and the owning rank broadcasts the\n// winning cluster members to all ranks.\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <numeric>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\n// (deterministic: every rank generates an identical data set)\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Grow a candidate cluster from a seed point.\n//\n// Semantically identical to repeatedly selecting, among unclustered points,\n// the candidate whose maximum distance to the current members is smallest\n// (ties -> lowest index) while that maximum stays below the threshold.\n// Optimizations (exact, no change in results):\n//  - the per-candidate max distance to the members is maintained incrementally\n//    (max is order-independent, so the values are bit-identical to recomputing);\n//  - a candidate whose max distance reaches the threshold can never become\n//    admissible again, so it is dropped from the active list permanently;\n//  - the active list stays in ascending index order, so a strict '<' scan\n//    yields the lowest-index minimum, as in the original tie-breaking.\n// Returns the cardinality; the members (insertion order) are written to `members`.\nint growCluster(const int seed,\n                const std::vector<char>& clustered,\n                const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                const double threshold,\n                const int point_count,\n                std::vector<double>& maxd,\n                std::vector<int>& active,\n                std::vector<int>& members) {\n    members.clear();\n    members.push_back(seed);\n\n    active.clear();\n    for (int c = 0; c < point_count; ++c) {\n        if (clustered[c] || c == seed) continue;\n        const double m = std::max(0.0, distance(points[c], points[seed]));\n        if (m < threshold) {\n            maxd[c] = m;\n            active.push_back(c);\n        }\n    }\n\n    while (!active.empty()) {\n        // Admissible candidate with the smallest max distance (lowest index on ties)\n        size_t bi = 0;\n        for (size_t i = 1; i < active.size(); ++i) {\n            if (maxd[active[i]] < maxd[active[bi]]) bi = i;\n        }\n        const int best = active[bi];\n        members.push_back(best);\n\n        // Update remaining candidates with the newly added member and prune\n        size_t w = 0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < active.size(); ++i) {\n            if (i == bi) continue;\n            const int c = active[i];\n            const double m = std::max(maxd[c], distance(points[c], points[best]));\n            if (m < threshold) {\n                maxd[c] = m;\n                active[w++] = c;\n            }\n        }\n        active.resize(w);\n    }\n\n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (collective: all ranks must call it)\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  const int rank,\n                                  const int nprocs,\n                                  MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices(N);\n    std::iota(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(), 0);\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    // Per-rank workspace\n    std::vector<double> maxd(N, 0.0);\n    std::vector<int> active;\n    active.reserve(N);\n    std::vector<int> cand;\n    std::vector<int> best_members;\n\n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        const size_t U = unclustered_indices.size();\n\n        // Local search: seeds at positions rank, rank+nprocs, ... (cyclic distribution)\n        int local_card = -1;\n        int local_seed = -1;\n        for (size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(rank); p < U; p += static_cast<size_t>(nprocs)) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[p];\n            const int card = growCluster(seed, clustered, points, threshold, N,\n                                         maxd, active, cand);\n            // Strict '>' keeps the lowest seed index among equal cardinalities\n            if (card > local_card) {\n                local_card = card;\n                local_seed = seed;\n                best_members.swap(cand);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Global winner: maximum cardinality, ties -> lowest seed index\n        struct { int val; int idx; } loc;\n        loc.val = local_card;\n        loc.idx = (local_seed >= 0) ? local_seed : N;\n        MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &loc, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC, comm);\n\n        const int max_cardinality = loc.val;\n        const int best_seed = loc.idx;\n        if (max_cardinality <= 0 || best_seed < 0 || best_seed >= N) {\n            break; // No more clusters can be formed\n        }\n\n        // The owner of the winning seed holds its members; broadcast them\n        const size_t pos = static_cast<size_t>(\n            std::lower_bound(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(), best_seed)\n            - unclustered_indices.begin());\n        const int root = static_cast<int>(pos % static_cast<size_t>(nprocs));\n\n        int len = (rank == root) ? static_cast<int>(best_members.size()) : 0;\n        MPI_Bcast(&len, 1, MPI_INT, root, comm);\n        best_members.resize(len);\n        MPI_Bcast(best_members.data(), len, MPI_INT, root, comm);\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n        cluster.members = best_members;\n        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));\n\n        // Mark all members as clustered\n        for (int m : best_members) {\n            clustered[m] = 1;\n        }\n\n        // Remove clustered points from unclustered list (order preserved)\n        unclustered_indices.erase(\n            std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                           [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx] != 0; }),\n            unclustered_indices.end()\n        );\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n    \n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n    \n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        \n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]], \n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        \n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", \n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n        \n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", \n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n    \n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    const MPI_Comm comm = MPI_COMM_WORLD;\n    int rank = 0;\n    int nprocs = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(comm, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(comm, &nprocs);\n    const bool root = (rank == 0);\n\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    int exit_code = 0;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments (identical on all ranks)\n    bool done = false;\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc && !done; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            done = true;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            exit_code = 1;\n            done = true;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (!done) {\n        if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\", \n                       num_points, threshold);\n            }\n            exit_code = 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (done || exit_code != 0) {\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return exit_code;\n    }\n    \n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n        printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d\\n\", nprocs);\n    }\n    \n    // Generate synthetic data (deterministic, replicated on every rank)\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n    \n    // Perform QT clustering\n    MPI_Barrier(comm);\n    const double t0 = MPI_Wtime();\n    \n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold, rank, nprocs, comm);\n    \n    MPI_Barrier(comm);\n    const double t1 = MPI_Wtime();\n    const long cluster_ms = static_cast<long>((t1 - t0) * 1000.0);\n    \n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Clustering time: %ld ms\\n\", cluster_ms);\n        printf(\"Clusters found: %zu\\n\", clusters.size());\n    }\n    \n    // Calculate statistics and performance metrics\n    int total_clustered = 0;\n    int max_cluster_size = 0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters.size(); ++i) {\n        const int size = static_cast<int>(clusters[i].members.size());\n        total_clustered += size;\n        max_cluster_size = std::max(max_cluster_size, size);\n    }\n    \n    const double avg_cluster_size = clusters.empty() ? 0.0 : \n        static_cast<double>(total_clustered) / clusters.size();\n    \n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Points clustered: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\\n\", \n               total_clustered, num_points, \n               100.0 * total_clustered / num_points);\n        printf(\"Average cluster size: %.2f\\n\", avg_cluster_size);\n        printf(\"Maximum cluster size: %d\\n\", max_cluster_size);\n        \n        // Performance metrics\n        const double time_sec = cluster_ms / 1000.0;\n        const double clusters_per_sec = clusters.size() / time_sec;\n        const double points_per_sec = num_points / time_sec;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.1f clusters/s, %.1f points/s\\n\", \n               clusters_per_sec, points_per_sec);\n    }\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults && root) {\n        // Serialize cluster membership for hashing\n        std::vector<double> membershipData;\n        membershipData.reserve(num_points);\n        std::vector<int> membership(num_points, -1);\n        for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n                membership[clusters[c].members[i]] = static_cast<int>(c);\n            }\n        }\n        for (int m : membership) {\n            membershipData.push_back(static_cast<double>(m));\n        }\n        print_results(membershipData, \"ClusterMembership\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation (performed on root; result shared with all ranks)\n    if (validate) {\n        int valid = 0;\n        if (root) {\n            valid = validateClusters(clusters, points, threshold) ? 1 : 0;\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(&valid, 1, MPI_INT, 0, comm);\n        \n        if (root) {\n            printf(valid ? \"Validation: PASSED\\n\" : \"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n        }\n        exit_code = valid ? 0 : 1;\n    }\n    \n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return exit_code;\n}\n"},"output":"Wrote file {"type":"text","timestamp":1793037870559,"sessionID":"ses_e86c4ad00ffebEWOAOBwCvDahy","part":{"id":"prt_179629cf50016KARwcOXAWxqvW","messageID":"msg_1796293cd001s2lfukY7bw1TP9","sessionID":"ses_e86c4ad00ffebEWOAOBwCvDahy","type":"text","text":"The qtclustering benchmark now runs on MPI unconditionally. Its output matches the original exactly, apart from timing lines, for every configuration I could run against it.\n\n**Changes (only `qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp` and `qtclustering/CMakeLists.txt`):**\n\n- **Distribution:** in each round, the candidate seeds are assigned cyclically across ranks. Each rank grows clusters for its own seeds.\n- **Selection:** an `MPI_Allreduce` with `MPI_MAXLOC` picks the largest cluster. Ties go to the lowest seed index, matching the original's strict `>` comparison.\n- **Broadcast:** the owning rank broadcasts the winning members, and every rank updates its clustered state.\n- **Algorithmic speedup, same results:** the original recomputed each candidate's distance to all members at every step. The new code updates a running max-distance incrementally and drops candidates that reach the threshold, since they can never become admissible again. Distances and tie-breaking are unchanged, so results are bit-identical. This alone made the single-rank run about 12x faster (2880 ms to 240 ms at n=1000).\n- **CMake:** `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` and linking `MPI::MPI_CXX`. The executable name is unchanged.\n- **Output:** only rank 0 prints. Validation runs on rank 0 and its result is broadcast so all ranks exit with the same code.\n\n**Verification:**\n\n- Compared against the original binary at n = 50, 300 and 1000, with thresholds from 1.0 to 3.0, on 1 through 64 ranks. The membership hash, cluster count and sample stats all match. Validation passes.\n- Error paths (`-h`, unknown option, invalid `-n`/`-t`) return the same codes on all ranks, with output printed once.\n- Clustering time at n=3000 on 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16 ranks: 1733, 895, 466, 249 and 140 ms.\n\n**Pre-existing issue, not changed:** `-n` values below 30 hang in `generateSyntheticData`, because `N / 30.0` truncates to zero and the group loop never adds points. The original has the same problem, so I left it alone.","time":{"start":1793037868277,"end":1793037870553}}}
